notes: Every s001–s008 and t001–t013 partitioned exactly once.

Superlative construct qodesh qodashim split as most (rectum, rule 19) + is holy (construct, rule 20); a single noncompositional most holy unit was the competing reading, and rule 2 prefers the split since each morpheme holds an English word.
Arthrous rendering of the rectum (the trespass offering) means nothing is fronted: the article takes t007 and the construct tôrat takes the supplied t004 (rule 29).
